name: Charles Thomas Petrillo

events.title: Marriage to Elsie Jaworski
events.description: License No. 1856 sworn 27 Aug 1934: Charles Petriello, 26, labor, b. Scranton, 1028 Bunker Hill St; Elsie Jaworski, 21, waitress, b. Scranton, 416 Christ Ct, daughter of the late Alexander and of Victoria (b. Poland). Married by Rev. Andrew Lychowicz, Scranton, Sept 1934 (day partly legible).

residences.place: 1028 Bunker Hill Street, Scranton Ward 10, Pennsylvania, USA
residences.note: Head, 33, laborer, outside work at mines; wife Elsie 26.

bioAdditions: Charles married Elsie Jaworski, a 21-year-old Polish-American waitress, in September 1934. On the license he gave his birthplace as Scranton, not Pittston (S1). In 1940 the couple rented one of the units at 1028 Bunker Hill Street beside his brothers James and Nicholas; he was a laborer doing outside work at the mines (S2).

conflicts.assessment: Unresolved; the license is self-reported. Pittston comes from the FS tree.
